## Endpoints

### Data Read (6)
- `GET /{id}` — Retrieve information about an item by ID.
- `GET /{id}/github` — Get GitHub information for an item.
- `GET /api/statuspage` — Check the current API status.
- `GET /contact/support` — Retrieve support contact information.
- `GET /docs/{docId}` — Retrieve a specific documentation page.
- `GET /integrations/{integrationId}` — Get details about a specific integration.

### Data Write (1)
- `POST /report-violation` — Report a violation or abuse.

### Search (1)
- `POST /1/indexes/*/queries` — Query an index for search results.

### Media (1)
- `GET /assets/homepage/pulse-audio.mp3` — Download an audio asset.

### Config (1)
- `POST /flags/` — Update a feature flag configuration.

## About This Skill

This skill provides access to Linear's internal API — the hidden endpoints that power their web/mobile app.
These are NOT official public APIs. They were captured by observing network traffic while using the site.

**Important:**
- Auth tokens in `auth.json` may expire — re-capture if you get 401 errors
- Internal APIs can change without notice — endpoints may break
- Rate limits are unknown — be conservative with request frequency

## When to Use This Skill

Use this skill when you need to:
- Access Linear data without official API access
- Automate actions on api.linear.app (faster than browser automation)
- Call the same endpoints the Linear frontend uses
